name: Custom connectors
short_description: A custom connector wraps a REST or SOAP API, typically described with OpenAPI, so that Azure Logic Apps, Power Automate, Power Apps and Copilot Studio can call it like a built-in connector with typed actions and configured authentication.

evidence.quote: But the more robust pattern for enterprise orchestration is the custom connector.
